 Order

Accused No.1 in Crime No.38/2023 registered by Venoor Police Station for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504 and 506 r/w Section 34 of IPC and Section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, is before this Court under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. On the basis of the complaint lodged by Smt. Asura Banu wife of the petitioner herein dated 10.07.2023, FIR in Crime No.38/2023 was registered against the petitioner and five others for the aforesaid offences.
In the complaint it is alleged that the marriage of the complainant with the petitioner was performed on 28.07.2019.
After marriage the complainant and other accused persons who are his close relatives were harassing and torturing the complainant and were demanding dowry.
Complainant has further alleged that the petitioner had a suspicious character.
She also has alleged that the petitioner was forcing her to have NC: 2023:KHC:33493 unnatural sex with him.
However, she had suffered all his acts with the hope that wisdom would prevail on her husband.
He has further alleged that on 14.10.2022 her father had paid a sum of Rs.4,80,000/- to the petitioner towards dowry.
Inspite of the same the petitioner and his family members continued to harass and torture the complainant.
Therefore, on 29.01.2023 she had left the matrimonial house and had taken shelter in the house of her parents.
Thereafter, on 10.07.2023 she had approached the Police and lodged the complaint which had resulted in registering FIR in Crime No.38/2023 against the petitioner and others.
Apprehending arrest in the said case, petitioner had filed Crl.Misc No.638/2023 before the Court of the III Additional District and Sessions Judge, D.K., Mangaluru which was dismissed on 04.08.2023.

entities.text: III Additional District and Sessions Judge, D.K., Mangaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition, prays to allow the petition.
Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the bail application.
6. From the reading of the complaint averments it is seen that omnibus allegations have been made against all the accused persons by the complainant.
There are no particulars of any specific incident regarding ill-treatment of torture meted out on her by the petitioner and other accused persons.
As per the complaint averments the complainant has left the matrimonial house on 29.01.2023 and had taken shelter in her parents house.
The complaint is thereafter lodged on 10.07.2023 which is after a period of nearly seven months.
The offences alleged are triable by the Court of Magistrate.
The petitioner is said to be working as an Assistant Professor.

Under the circumstances, I am of the view Mr Isak vs The State Of Karnataka on 14 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101085865/
2 that petitioner's prayer for grant of anticipatory bail is required to be answered in affirmative.

entities.text: Mr Isak vs The State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of NC: 2023:KHC:33493 Karnataka are directed to release the petitioner - accused in the event of his arrest in Crime No.38/2023 registered by Venoor Police Station, Dakshina Kannada for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504 and 506 r/w Section 34 of IPC and Section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, subject to the following conditions:
a) The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from the date of receipt of the copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
b) The petitioner shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.
c) The petitioner shall not tamper with the prosecution witness and he shall co-operate with the police for investigation and appear before them whenever called till filing of final report.
NC: 2023:KHC:33493 d) The petitioner shall not involve in similar offences in future.
